title: Correct height drop
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the vertical drop from A to C as h = l - OD = l - (2/3)l = (1/3)l.

title: Gravitational potential energy change
description: Essential: The response must state ΔE_p = -mgh = -(1/3)mgl, with correct sign indicating decrease.

title: Work done by gravity
description: Essential: The response must calculate W_gravity = mgh = (1/3)mgl, with correct positive sign.

title: Relationship between work and ΔE_p
description: Important: The response must correctly relate work done by gravity to potential energy change via ΔE_p = -W_gravity.

title: Consistent units and symbols
description: Optional: The response uses consistent notation (m, g, l) and includes appropriate units (J) or dimensional analysis.

title: Sign error in ΔE_p
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the sign of ΔE_p is incorrect (e.g., stated as positive) or if the relationship ΔE_p = -W_gravity is misapplied.

title: Incorrect height calculation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the vertical drop is miscalculated (e.g., using OD directly as h, or misinterpreting geometry).
